topics.label: The More Of Year
topics.summary: Too many slide decks, not enough live product demos. Loved the content but we never got to audience questions because we ran out of time. Wish every breakout had a hands-on component like the logistics one did.

topics.label: The Wifi Breakout Session
topics.summary: Wifi in Breakout Room B was unreliable during the session. Couldn't get the conference wifi to connect on my laptop all morning. Sessions kept running over, which pushed Q&A out entirely in two of the four.
